title: runner → studio: one output object written
description: Subject evt.run.<host>.<session_id>.output (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:<attempt>:<seq>. Sent after the object is fully written to the object store, before the terminal status. `key` is under the command's output_prefix: an image is <output_prefix><index>.png, a video <output_prefix><index>.mp4 (H.264 yuv420p + AAC, moov atom first: -movflags +faststart) with its poster <output_prefix><index>.poster.png (frame 0, the video's size), both written before this event.

index.description: the output's number in the run, from 0 (key <output_prefix><index>.<ext>)

etag.description: the object's content hash: md5 hex of its bytes (the S3 ETag of the single-part PUT); studio stores it as the take's etag, so the take can be used as an input image without re-reading it. Absent: studio hashes the object when the take is first used

seed.description: the seed this output was made with

resolved.description: the values the runner chose for params set to "auto", as evt.run.status `resolved.params` (so the take's made_with has them when the projector stores it); absent when none

params.description: `<node>.<param>` -> the value the runner chose for a param the run set to "auto" (a frames param: the predicted length, on its grid). Studio records it in made_with.inputs (made_with.typed keeps "auto")

attempt.description: the attempt of cmd.run.execute this event belongs to; absent = 1. seq restarts at 1 for each attempt; the projector dedupes on (job_id, attempt, seq) and drops events of an attempt that is not the run's current one

video.description: kind video only (required then, absent for an image): the clip's metadata, from the file the runner wrote

duration_s.description: frames / fps, the video stream's length in seconds

has_audio.description: true when the MP4 has an audio track (LTX: AAC 48 kHz stereo)

poster.description: the poster image: frame 0 as PNG, the take's thumbnail

last.description: from API 1.17: the last frame as PNG at the video's size, <output_prefix><index>.last.png, written before this event (New shot's "start from the previous clip's last frame" copies it; absent from older runners: studio then extracts it with a media job)

stream.description: from API 1.17: the stream facts of the MP4 (the export plan's input); absent = not probed (the plan re-encodes that clip: not_probed)

source_map.description: API 1.19, a video made from a media take (ltx retake, extend, audio to video): how its time lines up with that take; studio stores it as Take.source_map. Absent otherwise
